topic: Comparisons of motivation, health behaviors, and functional status among elders in residential homes in Korea

sources.title: Comparisons of motivation, health behaviors, and functional status among elders in residential homes in Korea
sources.authors: Song R, June KJ, Kim CG, Jeon MY.

findings.finding: The motivation to perform health behaviors, especially regarding perceived benefits, improved significantly for participants compared to dropouts.
findings.quote: The motivation to perform health behaviors, especially for perceived benefits, improved significantly for the participants than for the dropouts.

findings.finding: Significant differences were found in the performance of overall health behaviors and exercise-related behaviors between participants and dropouts.
findings.quote: Significant differences in the performance of overall health behaviors and exercise-related behaviors were found between the participants and the dropouts.

findings.finding: The sickness impact profile of participants improved significantly, showing differences in total SIP, physical dimensions, and enjoyment of recreation.
findings.quote: The sickness impact profile (SIP) of the participants improved significantly, compared with the dropouts. Significant group differences were found for total SIP, physical dimensions, and enjoyment of recreation and pastimes.

principle: A motivation enhancement exercise program improves the motivation for health behaviors and enhances the functional status and physical dimensions of older adults over time.
for_the_teacher: Include motivation enhancement strategies and emphasize perceived benefits to help older learners maintain consistent attendance.
